// diagnostic

E1246

Signature verification failed for `{name}` {version}: the signature doesn't match the recorded public key.

What

Signature verification failed for `{name}` {version}: the signature doesn't match the recorded public key.

Why

This means the package was tampered with after signing, or the index entry is corrupt — the author's Ed25519 signature over the content hash no longer checks out (D-PKGSIGN1).

Fix

Do not use this version. Re-run `jet fetch` after clearing the store entry; if the problem persists, report it — this should never happen for an untampered registry.
